headline: Bring consistency and empathy to return review without automating the decision.
capabilities: Automatically evaluate and classify return requests
Prioritize complaints with high sentiment, draft tailored responses, and execute resolution options
Analyze SKU patterns for quality issues and suspicious behavior
Recommend resolution strategies based on customer value
outcomes: Reduced fraudulent returns and improved early defect detection
Increased customer retention by applying recovery strategies that preserve lifetime value
why_try: It helps service, quality, and loss-prevention teams review the same evidence while preserving authorization, privacy, and non-accusatory language.

sample_prompts.label: Review an anonymous return case
sample_prompts.prompt: Summarize the anonymous return review evidence and approval boundary.

sample_prompts.label: Classify a complaint safely
sample_prompts.prompt: Classify this product concern without echoing personal information or sending a response.

sample_prompts.label: Draft a resolution option
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft a policy-grounded option and keep all actions behind authorization.

sample_prompts.label: Analyze aggregate quality trends
sample_prompts.prompt: Summarize aggregate defect and return patterns without accusing any person.

business_flow: Customer Service Agent, Quality Team, and Loss Prevention Team
Approved read-only CRM, order, and policy evidence
